note: Set B is more accurate on grid spacing, correctly identifying axes (e.g., 5 to 6) whereas Set A hallucinates grid lines from detail callouts (e.g., 'Grid 5 to C4'). Both sets contain contradictory claims regarding the 9'-0" and 8'-8 5/8" vertical dimensions (some claims correctly attribute them to Grade-to-T.O. Steel, others incorrectly to First Floor-to-T.O. Steel), but Set B has a higher ratio of correct attributions for the 8'-8 5/8" dimension. Set A includes a useful total width claim (32'-0") missing from B, but its factual errors on entity binding outweigh this.
remarks: Both sets struggle with the contradictory dimensioning on the drawing (elevations sum differently than dimension lines), leading to internal contradictions in both claim sets. Set A's treatment of 'C4' (a detail marker) as a grid line is a clear entity extraction error.
